messages:
Ava: kicking off a v2.1-int4 shadow -> green run for prod-candidates, noticed an odd fingerprint shift on long-doc cohort 'ld-heavy-12'. simscore down ~6% vs baseline.
Raj: which metric? avg embedding cosine, or rerank concordance?
Ava: embedding cosine (mean sim). rerank MRR also down but noisier. I pulled a quick slice: long docs >1k tokens, system prompts with code examples.
Mike: can you paste the small diff table?
Ava: sure
Ava: ```
slice       | baseline_mean | int4_mean | delta
ld-heavy-12 | 0.842         | 0.792     | -0.050 (-5.9%)
other-long  | 0.812         | 0.809     | -0.003 (-0.4%)
short-synth | 0.901         | 0.899     | -0.002 (-0.2%)
```
Lisa: auto-fallback policy for canaries uses concordance drop >5% sustained for 15m OR any slice >8% for 5m, right?
Sophia: our documented thresholds: model-level >4% for 30m OR slice-level >6% for 10m triggers autofallback. But there are older envs with different settings.
Tom: current canary traffic is 8% to int4 v2.1 across all traffic. if ld-heavy-12 is showing -5.9% that's borderline.
Raj: is this reproducible in shadow offline eval? run full eval on seeded set and compare logits/embeds.
Ava: kicked off shadow-eval job `eval-shadow/1748884321` against seedset + 3 replicates. ETA ~12m.
deploy-bot: canary-deploy v2.1-int4 -> 8% traffic started at 1748884300. monitor URL: https://ops/redwood/canary/1748884321
Mike: we should also check KV-cache warmup diff. long-docs benefit from KV; quantization can change attention scaling a bit.
Ava: good point — pulling KV hit-rate and prefix mismatch logs.
Ava: KV hit-rate looks identical, but there are token-prefix embedding norm shifts on first 200 tokens.
Lisa: ops question: do we want to throttle traffic to 1% while we triage? safer if we lower blast radius.
Sophia: +1 to throttling to 1% and let shadow-eval finish. If shadow shows consistent drop, autofallback should trigger but we still want manual eyes.
Raj: also run small ablation: v2.1-int4 with calibrated outlier-clipping turned on (quant clip=0.02) — hypothesis: reduces fingerprint drift.
Tom: if we can flip clip quickly, we can test at 1% for 20m.
Ava: I'll cut traffic to 1% now.
deploy-bot: update: canary-traffic set to 1% at 1748884420 by Ava
Mike: FYI, if autofallback threshold crosses in 10m window, system will rollback automatically to v2.0-restore. notify-channel is eng-ml & incidents.
Ava: shadow-eval finished: delta table (replicate mean): ld-heavy-12 -5.6%, rerank MRR -2.3% (consistent).
Ava: starting quick test with quant clip=0.02 on a shadow replica.
Sophia: ok let's let that run. if clip reduces delta to <3% we can adjust canary policy or add slice-specific exemptions.
Raj: we should also log this as a fingerprint regression case in the model-onboard tracker and tag for postmortem if we end up rolling back.
Ava: added ticket M-4742 with links to evals and logs.
Tom: thanks — keep me posted. I'll standby to trigger autofallback if thresholds breach.
Lisa: noted. :eyes:
Ava: thanks all, I'll post final outcome in 10-15m.
deploy-bot: monitor health: 10m window checks running (latency, errors, simscore slices).
